chapters.title: Arrival
chapters.text: Marlow: So you're the one with the tired 200BX. You owe me for the garage space. The streets open at night - win something and start paying it back.

chapters.title: Getting noticed
chapters.text: Unknown number: People are talking about the 200BX on the coast road. Vex's crew wants to know who you are. Keep winning and you'll find out why that matters.

chapters.title: Sponsorship
chapters.text: Marlow: A parts shop downtown wants its name on your car. Faster rivals are coming out now - don't embarrass them.

chapters.title: Betrayal
chapters.text: Vex: Marlow never told you who bought your debt, did he? It was me. Race me for it. Lose and the car is mine.

chapters.title: Taking the city
chapters.text: Marlow: Vex's crew is falling apart. One last run across the whole city and Belasco is yours.
